batch: 4 scenes per update, one per capability; deterministically cycle declared fit profiles; equal scene weight; same padded learner tokens and updates in every arm, no claim of exact total FLOPs matching
construction: Normal 8000 LP deck-only starts. Seat0 waits through a legal first turn; low LP only via card costs/damage. Preparation decisions remain in RNN history with zero CE and KL weight. Original legal observations and actions only.
split: All descendants remain development-family lineage. Six fit profiles and three reserved development-combination profiles fixed before fitting. No unseen-family claim; old synthetic fixtures remain evaluation only.
contrasts: Every one of 36 contexts has two repeated success/failure branches, matching decision roots and independent subprocess core replay audits. No training on invalid or nonreproducible scenes.
evaluation: Baseline and fixed endpoints: 36 contextual openings plus 36 critical suffix roots and the base Halq root (73 normal roots; alternative routes can share opening observations), and four old synthetic tasks; each repeated twice and independently audited. Probes only base and seat-low normal contexts. Frozen reserved combinations never select sampling or checkpoints.
success_gate: Expanded KL must pass all 73 normal roots and all four old synthetic tasks without regressing any originally passed root; report fit, reserved development combinations, old synthetic separately. No production promotion even on success.
stop: 1536 updates/arm, nonfinite gradient or params, RNN parity mismatch, asset drift, invalid state, time budget, or reference/audit failure. No automatic extension, PPO or native replacement. Costs of collection/preflight/fit/audit reported separately.
